title: All Figured Out
description: a joke resource pack that replaces most of the warden's sounds with the figure's voicelines (voiced by IThundxr) from doors's 2024 april fools update
body: as the summary says, this is a joke resource pack that replaces most of the warden's sounds with the figure's voicelines (voiced by IThundxr) from doors's 2024 april fools update. the sound files might be a tad bit loud, i didnt make them any quieter than their files on the wiki.
